facts.text: Penn Wynne developed in the early twentieth century from the Greenhill Farms plantation, which was established in the seventeenth century by Thomas Lloyd.
The Penn Wynne Library opened in 1929, followed shortly by the opening of the Penn Wynne Elementary School in 1930.
Penn Wynne has held a Fourth of July Parade every year since 1943 to support neighbors fighting in World War II.
The Penn Wynne Civic Association convinced developers to build detached single-family homes rather than the denser twin homes common in the pre-war era.
Lankenau Hospital moved from North Philadelphia to its current home in Penn Wynne in 1953 on the former Overbrook Country Club grounds.
Lower Merion Township purchased a ten-acre parcel of land to create the public space now known as Penn Wynne Park.
